**New evidence**
- `SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Ethiopian Investment Holding Launch Event","publisher":"Ethiopian Investment Holdings","publication_date":"2022-06-23","url":"https://eih.et/ethiopian-investment-holding-launch-event/","claim":"At EIH's first conference, the finance minister said EIH's mission was to usher in global investment and modern capabilities, and EIH said it was building a public-wealth-management team to optimize public assets.","locator":"lines 53-56","source_type":"official","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Direct institutional statement on the newly created holding company and its mandate; strong for existence and stated purpose, weaker for outcomes.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Exact 2022 launch and mandate evidence.","ruler_attribution":"High for government action under Abiy's administration; limited for effectiveness because this is the institution describing itself.","contrary_evidence":["A mandate statement does not prove implementation or results."],"lenses":["8B.2","8B.4","8B.5","8B.6","8B.10"]}`
- `SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"With Active Private Participation, Ethiopia’s Economy Will Grow More: Senior PM Advisor","publisher":"Ethiopian News Agency","publication_date":"2022-09-07","url":"https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/en_38237","claim":"Mamo Mihretu said the administration was taking progressive reform measures to open the telecom, logistics, and financial sectors and described this as the government's declared intention.","locator":"article paragraph with 'We have opened up the telecom sector...'","source_type":"official","source_confidence":"medium_high","source_confidence_reason":"Government-aligned official reporting of a senior advisor's interview; good for declared direction, not independent proof of success.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Directly in-period 2022 statement of program direction.","ruler_attribution":"High for state direction because the senior advisor and EIH CEO are speaking for the administration; limited because this is still declaratory.","contrary_evidence":["The article is self-reporting and also mixes in performance claims that may reflect external conditions."],"lenses":["8B.1","8B.2","8B.7","8B.10"]}`
- `SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"IMF Staff Visit Discusses Reform Plans and Economic Developments in Ethiopia","publisher":"IMF","publication_date":"2022-06-21","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2022/06/21/pr22216-ethiopia-imf-staff-visit-discusses-reform-plans-and-economic-developments-in-ethiopia","claim":"IMF staff said the authorities remained committed to structural reforms for a transition to private-sector-led growth, including better public investment efficiency, SOE oversight, FX reforms, and modernization of monetary policy.","locator":"press release paragraphs on reform plans and macroeconomic developments","source_type":"IGO","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Independent multilateral staff assessment with direct country-visit discussion; strong for reform content and constraint context.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Exact 2022 reform agenda and implementation context.","ruler_attribution":"Moderate-high: the reform agenda is attributable to the Abiy government, but the IMF is describing commitments and early implementation under severe shocks.","contrary_evidence":["The staff visit records intent and early progress, not full year-end delivery."],"lenses":["8B.1","8B.2","8B.3","8B.7","8B.8","8B.10"]}`
- `SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Ethiopia grants Safaricom mobile money service licence -finance minister","publisher":"Reuters via MarketScreener","publication_date":"2022-10-06","url":"https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/SAFARICOM-PLC-6500172/news/Ethiopia-grants-Safaricom-mobile-money-service-licence-finance-minister-41943756/","claim":"Ethiopia's finance minister said the government had granted Safaricom a licence to operate a mobile money service after the company switched on its network in Addis Ababa.","locator":"headline and lead sentence","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Reuters report syndicated by MarketScreener; concrete, attributable implementation step with clear date.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Exact 2022 implementation of telecom liberalization.","ruler_attribution":"Moderate-high: the government action is explicit, but the operational rollout is carried by Safaricom and regulators rather than Abiy personally.","contrary_evidence":["A single licence does not establish broad sector reform completion."],"lenses":["8B.2","8B.4","8B.6","8B.7"]}`
- `SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Ethiopian airlines revenues, profit jump in FY 21/22","publisher":"Reuters via MarketScreener","publication_date":"2022-08-31","url":"https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Ethiopian-airlines-revenues-profit-jump-in-FY-21-22-41655941/","claim":"State-run Ethiopian Airlines reported a 90 percent jump in net profit to 937 million dollars and a 79 percent rise in revenue to 5 billion dollars for FY 2021/22, with higher passengers and lower operating costs.","locator":"headline and lines 820-834","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Reuters reporting on a major state enterprise outcome with specific figures and operating drivers.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Directly covers FY 2021/22, overlapping the 2022 period.","ruler_attribution":"Limited and indirect: the result is relevant to state-owned enterprise performance under the EIH umbrella, but it is not a clean measure of Abiy's personal management.","contrary_evidence":["Performance may reflect post-pandemic rebound and external demand, not just governance."],"lenses":["8B.7","8B.9","8B.10"]}`
- `SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"The Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia: Request of an Arrangement Under the Extended Credit Facility","publisher":"IMF","publication_date":"2024","url":"https://www.elibrary.imf.org/abstract/journals/002/2024/253/article-A001-en.xml","claim":"The IMF said Ethiopian Investment Holdings and PEHAA substantially modernized and centralized SOE oversight and fiscal risk management, and that 23 of 35 supervised SOEs had produced audited financial statements for 2021/22 by October 2023.","locator":"Section H, State-Owned Enterprise Policy, paragraph 46","source_type":"IGO","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Independent IMF program document with concrete audit/oversight milestones and institutional assessment.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Retrospective on reforms created in 2022 and their audited-account effects through 2023; useful corroboration of 2022 institutional design.","ruler_attribution":"Moderate: the institutions are government-created, but the specific performance gains are reported later and are not uniquely attributable to Abiy personally.","contrary_evidence":["The report also notes remaining delays in publishing some EIH financial statements."],"lenses":["8B.4","8B.5","8B.6","8B.10"]}`

**Gap status**
- 2022 reform announcements turning into observable implementation and outcomes by year-end: **partly resolved**.
- Abiy's personal management of coordination and bottlenecks inside ministries and SOEs: **partly resolved**.
- Whether reform institutions like EIH and the auditor-general actually improved discipline versus only creating new structures: **partly resolved**.

**Search and rejection summary**
- Considered roughly 20 documents in this gap round, centered on EIH, ENA reform reporting, IMF 2022 and 2024 materials, Reuters syndication items, The Reporter audit coverage, and a few later retrospective government pages.
- Kept only sources that added a materially new 2022 claim about program direction, implementation, outcomes, or oversight.
- Rejected or downgraded 2025-2026 retrospectives as out-of-period for the 2022 question, unless they directly summarized 2021/22 audited outcomes.
- Rejected generic "reform momentum" pages that repeated the same claim without new implementation detail.
- IMF eLibrary direct opening hit an internal error, so I relied on the abstract/snippet for the 2024 SOE-oversight finding.
- Reuters syndication pages were treated as one canonical Reuters claim each rather than duplicated across mirrors.

**Remaining gaps**
- The main unrecoverable piece is the internal decision trail: public sources still do not show how Abiy personally managed bottlenecks, replaced blockers, or enforced follow-through inside ministries and SOEs.
- More search would help modestly if you want cabinet minutes, board minutes, or 2022 budget-execution/audit documents, but the public record is already close to saturated for this period.
- No score assigned.
